title: On Building the wall in a single summer
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：build　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 build 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the driver ① built the wall in a single summer in the rain, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② builds the wall in a single summer without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ build the wall in a single summer at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ built the wall in a single summer before — a line in the timetable for February 1968 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Building the wall in a single summer in the rain, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ build a name for careful work without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Build a name for careful work at once and never mention it again.

By 1981 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ builds a name for careful work in the rain every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ built the wall in a single summer again when nobody else would.

⑩ To build the wall in a single summer, my mother said in 1986, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody builds the wall in a single summer without complaint again and somebody must build the wall in a single summer in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 砌起（一般过去式 built the wall in a single summer：1974 年司机头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 砌起（一般现在 builds the wall in a single summer：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 砌起（不定式 to build the wall in a single summer：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 砌起（过去完成时 had built the wall in a single summer：1968 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 砌起（动名词 building the wall in a single summer 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 建立（build a name for careful work：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去建立做起事来仔细的名声）
G. v. 建立（build a name for careful work：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 砌起（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 builds a name for careful work，而母亲又一次 built the wall in a single summer）

answers.why: build 意为“砌起”，1974 年司机淋着雨砌起一个夏天砌起那道墙，那是车站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 built。
build 意为“砌起”，自那以后司机毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 builds。
build 意为“砌起”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯砌起一个夏天砌起那道墙”，此处为不定式 to build the wall in a single summer。
build 意为“砌起”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1981 年之前就有人砌起过，故用过去完成时 had built。
build 意为“砌起”，司机说“砌起一个夏天砌起那道墙这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 building the wall in a single summer 作主语。
build 意为“建立”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去建立做起事来仔细的名声”，should ever 之后用原形 build a name for careful work。
build 意为“建立”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻建立做起事来仔细的名声（build a name for careful work at once），以后再也不要提起。
build 意为“砌起”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例建立做起事来仔细的名声，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 builds。
build 意为“砌起”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨砌起一个夏天砌起那道墙，用一般过去式 built 叙述。
build 意为“砌起”，结尾那句是母亲 1986 年的话：要砌起一个夏天砌起那道墙，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

多年以后，司机仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（builds the wall in a single summer）

司机说过，淋着雨砌起一个夏天砌起那道墙这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（building the wall in a single summer 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻建立做起事来仔细的名声，以后再也不要提起。（build a name for careful work，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 build 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the driver built the wall in a single summer in the rain, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver builds the wall in a single summer without complaint whenever the station asks.
Building the wall in a single summer in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever build a name for careful work without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station builds a name for careful work in the rain every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother built the wall in a single summer again, and the station remembered that half.
